note: Mechanical only. OBSERVED true can set features. UNKNOWN never sets dangerous features true. INFERENCE is not a slot status. LLM does not choose methods.

status_semantics.OBSERVED: quote in materials; value true/false must match quote
status_semantics.NOT_OBSERVED: materials explicitly say absent (なし, 変更なし, REOPENではない)

slot_to_feature.when: all of state/goal/claim/hypothesis are NOT_OBSERVED or OBSERVED false
stdout_present OBSERVED true OR runtime_issue_observed OBSERVED true
stdout_present and runtime_issue_observed both NOT_OBSERVED or OBSERVED false
evidence_content_mismatch OBSERVED true OR evidence_content_known OBSERVED false
stdout_present OBSERVED true AND llm_handoff_present OBSERVED true
ranking_filter_separated NOT_OBSERVED/false AND ranking_present and collect_filter_present OBSERVED true
evidence_present OBSERVED true AND evidence_freshness_known UNKNOWN

derived_flags.reopen_validation_required: reopen OBSERVED true AND (evidence_exists_known not OBSERVED true OR evidence_content_known not OBSERVED)
derived_flags.runtime_diagnosis_confidence: HIGH_RISK if runtime_issue UNKNOWN and code OBSERVED; NO_LOGS if has_runtime_logs false; else LOGS_PRESENT

safety_locks.runtime_log_なし: force has_runtime_logs=false regardless of LLM slots
